features: Electric can opener with precision Power Cut blade
Press-and-release lever for easily opening any standard-size can

description: Style, convenience, and power come together in the Cuisinart electric can open. With chrome accents and elegant contours, it fits nicely with other modern countertop appliances. The easy single-touch operation effortlessly opens any standard size can. The precision Power Cut blade and strong magnetic lid holder are attached to the removable lever, which can be easily detached for quick cleanups. A stable design with a wide base for extra sturdiness and solid construction, it won't tip or slide.
